At x=24,y=8, place the exact heading 「強調したコードの例」 in Meiryo Regular 12px, line-height 16px, color #047857. Below it, at x=24,y=42, draw a pale mint #ECFDF5 code block 342×62px with a compact 10px left inset. Place the exact literal code string at x=34,y=53 in Meiryo Regular 12px, line-height 16px, color #1D1D1D:
<メモ>一緒に進めましょう。</メモ>

Preserve the angle brackets as literal code characters. This is markup shown as code, not a hyperlink; do not color it blue or reinterpret the tags. Keep the code text dark. Preserve the title's green color and the code block's pale green surface. Match exact dimensions, spacing, alignment, and crop. Add no icons, quotes, border, shadow, syntax highlighting, or extra copy.
